metadata.description: V2 list device sensors for organization group. Live-captured against an org group with zero sensors configured -- this is the genuine empty-list response shape (result_set/total_results, not the V1 Page/PageSize/Result wrapper). Distinct from list_sensors.json (V1, itself also an empty-list response -- 204 with a null body, not a populated result -- kept as-is; see that file's own allowlist entry for its provenance).
